SELECT USR.COMPANY_CD ,(SELECT COMP_NM FROM T_COMPANY WHERE COMPANY_CD = USR.COMPANY_CD) AS COMPANY_NM ,USR.USER_CD ,USR.USER_NM ,USR.USER_ENG_NM ,USR.DEPT_CD ,DEP.DEPT_NM ,USR.USER_TITLE ,(SELECT CODE_NM FROM T_CODE CODE WHERE CODE.UP_CODE_ID = 'USER_TITLE' AND CODE.CODE_ID = USR.USER_TITLE) AS USER_TITLE_NM ,USR.USER_POSIT ,(SELECT CODE_NM FROM T_CODE CODE WHERE CODE.UP_CODE_ID = 'USER_POSIT' AND CODE.CODE_ID = USR.USER_POSIT) AS USER_POSIT_NM ,USR.O_PHONE ,USR.M_PHONE ,USR.EMAIL ,USR.USER_WORK ,USR.MULTI_LANG ,USR.USER_IMG ,ISNULL(USR.USE_YN,'N') AS USE_YN ,USR.REG_DT ,USR.REG_USR ,USR.MOD_DT ,USR.MOD_USR ,ISNULL(USR.MGR_YN,'N') AS MGR_YN ,ISNULL(USR.MBO_YN,'N') AS MBO_YN ,ISNULL(USR.SA_YN,'N') AS SA_YN ,USR.DSTR_CHN FROM T_USER USR LEFT JOIN T_DEPARTMENT DEP ON USR.DEPT_CD = DEP.DEPT_CD
WHERE 1=1
AND USR.DEPT_CD = #selPart3#
AND (DEP.UP_DEPT_CD = #selPart2# OR USR.DEPT_CD = #selPart2#)
AND (DEP.UP_DEPT_CD in (SELECT DEPT_CD FROM T_DEPARTMENT WHERE DEPT_CD = #selPart1#) OR USR.DEPT_CD = #selPart1#)
AND USR.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd#
AND USR.USE_YN = #searchUseYn#
AND USR.USER_NM LIKE '%' + #searchUserNm# + '%'
AND USR.USER_CD = #userCd#
ORDER BY USR.USER_NM

INSERT INTO T_USER ( COMPANY_CD ,USER_CD ,USER_NM ,USER_ENG_NM ,DEPT_CD ,USER_TITLE ,USER_POSIT ,O_PHONE ,M_PHONE ,EMAIL ,USER_WORK ,MULTI_LANG
,PASSWD ,USE_YN ,REG_DT ,REG_USR ,MOD_DT ,MOD_USR ,MGR_YN ,MBO_YN ,SA_YN ,DSTR_CHN ) VALUES ( #companyCd# , #userCd# , #userNm# , #userEngNm# , #deptCd# , #userTitle# , #userPosit# , #qPhone# , #mPhone# , #email# , #userWork# , #multiLang#
, #passwd# , #useYn# , GETDATE() , #regUsrCd# , GETDATE() , #regUsrCd# , #mgr_Yn# , #mbo_Yn# , #sa_Yn# , #dstrChn# )
statements.update: UPDATE T_USER SET USER_CD = #userCd# ,USER_NM = #userNm# ,USER_ENG_NM = #userEngNm# ,DEPT_CD = #deptCd# ,USER_TITLE = #userTitle# ,USER_POSIT = #userPosit# ,O_PHONE = #qPhone# ,M_PHONE = #mPhone# ,EMAIL = #email# ,USER_WORK = #userWork# ,MULTI_LANG = #multiLang# ,USE_YN = #useYn# ,MOD_DT = GETDATE() ,MOD_USR = #regUsrCd# ,MGR_YN = #mgr_Yn# ,MBO_YN = #mbo_Yn# ,SA_YN = #sa_Yn# ,DSTR_CHN = #dstrChn# WHERE COMPANY_CD = #companyCd# AND USER_CD = #preUserCd#
